I've used the comply foam tips (or whatever foam tips came with earbuds if I got lucky enough) for ages, but they'd always get super gross with earwax or sweat or dirt and leaves from mowing the lawn but they're (especially the comply ones) super expensive.

This item worked as it should have with very mild use and was not moved around. the first problem i have is that all the ports are facing opposite of the power source and data connection, meaning any device you have with activity lights you wont see the activity because the usb ports are reversed. the front charging ports charge quickly and are the only ports working now. there is no data synch in the 7 ports but it still charges.

How much you’re going to like and get out of this is going to depend a lot on both what you are using it for and your other products that you are using it with. What I mean by that is if you have high quality accessories or other products in your system then you will likely feel like this is amazing. If you have really subpar/cheap ones you will likely not find that it’s worth it.

Or at least that’s my take away from it. I spent 2 weeks with this and honestly couldn’t figure out what the hype was about. But I also have a bare bone setup with cheap products because I’m just starting out. Yet I let a friend borrow this for a week and he was blown away by it. So of course I had to see what he was talking about and it worked amazing with his stuff. So it’s all just going to depend on what else you have.

Connection is easy, did not need a CD to install. Just went to 192.168.0.1 in internet browser and worked. The rage is decent, the same as my old wireless G router; about 55 feet using my phone I get about 1 to 2 bars signal and can watch a YouTube video. Only gripe, and it's a huge one, using the USB port makes the router stop working. Every time I try to connect to the media device on the router, it disconnects and drops the signal. I wont be using the USB, that's for sure.
